long_biography.plain_text:
Management consulting gave Marco Piana his first professional base at McKinsey's Milan office. He entered private equity at Investitori Associati in 2003, followed by positions at Magenta and 3i and a partnership at Fondo Italiano d'Investimento. In 2011, he created his own investment platform using personal capital and began accepting outside money two years later.

That platform, VAM, applies majority investment and buy-and-build methods to medium-sized companies. Piana's transactions have crossed industrials, travel, healthcare and business services, while portfolio governance forms part of the firm's hands-on approach. He studied engineering at Politecnico di Torino before completing an MBA at Columbia Business School.
